question.text: The value of n in the molecular formula <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>18</mn></mrow></msub></math> is

solution.text:
For BenAl2Si6O18

According to charge balance in a molecule,

2n + 6 + 24 - 36 = 0

This gives, n = 3
